title: VIRTUA STRIKER 2 '98 / SEGA SPORTS UPRIGHT
variant: White Sega Virtua Striker 2 sports upright running the '98 Model 3 update; retained base-game soccer-player sides and marquee, teal deck
preview_note: 40 x 56 px | white Sega upright / teal deck / 2 green sticks + 6 actions / real '98 display

cabinet.purpose: Front photograph indexed as vs298; corroborates retained Virtua Striker 2 marquee, white shell, teal panel, green sticks, three colored actions per player and two yellow Start buttons.
cabinet.rights: Underlying Sega artwork/trademarks; archive hosting is not publisher authorization. Photo author, restoration status and redistribution rights are unknown.

side_cabinet.purpose: Three-quarter base Virtua Striker 2 cabinet photograph; corroborates same white shell, teal deck and blue soccer-player/stadium side print. One documented side repeated readably; not a claim of unique 98-version side artwork.
side_cabinet.rights: Underlying Sega artwork/trademarks; archive hosting is not publisher authorization. Photo author, restoration status and redistribution rights are unknown.

controls_alternative.purpose: Archive vs298 camouflaged-green alternative panel, used only to corroborate two joysticks and three actions; NOT mixed with the selected photographed teal cabinet deck.
controls_alternative.rights: Underlying Sega artwork/trademarks; archive hosting is not publisher authorization. Photo author, restoration status and redistribution rights are unknown.

flyer.purpose: Scan of 1997 Sega printed operator flyer: Model 3, two players and joystick plus three-button controls. Base game documentation, not misidentified as a 98-specific flyer or publisher-hosted master.
flyer.rights: Underlying Sega artwork/trademarks; archive hosting is not publisher authorization. Photo author, restoration status and redistribution rights are unknown.

screen.purpose: Native 496x384 Virtua Striker 2 98 field/players attract display captured from the supplied local ~/Downloads/vs298.zip with this repository's Supermodel web core (pinned 8b4de239bf3e0fd921f4383edcd3c21c2e62067b). Own headless Chrome; harness warmup=600 play frames=1800, native canvas export (no UI). Reproduce with node supermodel/harness/run.mjs '?rom=vs298&warmup=600&play&frames=1800' art/references/vs298/screen.png --canvas, while the local harness server runs. No ROM fetched or uploaded.
screen.rights: Game imagery Sega, captured from already supplied local ROM; no redistribution license inferred.

uncertainties: Variant is a documented Sega white sports upright running the 98 update with retained base Virtua Striker 2 prints, not a fabricated dedicated 98 decal kit. Exact region/model and original-versus-restored print authenticity are unverified.
No publisher-hosted master was located. Copyright/photograph redistribution rights remain unresolved; archive access is not deployment permission.
Side photo is only 182x320; rectification and pixel-size filtering limit logo/player detail. One photographed print is repeated with readable orientation; the unseen opposite original is unverified.

Teal deck is extracted from the selected front cabinet photo. The separately archived camo-green panel is not used as its texture. Two yellow Start buttons remain photographed, not extra modeled actions.

Geometry is a low-resolution interpretation: white stepped sides, black hood/bezel, broad CRT, overhanging panel and white fascia, center coin door with gray recesses and dark foot. Dimensions are world-space estimates, not measured plans.
